scope: Newly generated 16 PNG body poses, native cropped originals, 1008x567 app-size bright/dark previews and larger maximum-native-canvas diagnostics. No final application integration or smooth-interpolation verdict.

generation.actual_size_note: Generation tool returned1254 sheets despite2048 prompt. Acceptance uses measured frame quality and actual display, not the requested dimension.

observations: All16 preserve pale-orange screen-left ear/forehead, muted-brown screen-right ear/forehead, central cream stripe, cream body and one cream tail on screen right.
No additional limbs, detached ears, hats, red cheek circles, new patches or tail stripes found.
Signature pose holds its own attached curved tail near face and peeks beside it; the tail remains a single connected structure.
Blink/success/nap eye closures and open-mouth changes are intended expression variations.
Native originals/crops are unmodified RGBA. Exact extraction verified by helper.
Main outline is coherent on light and dark; no visible colored fringe, background remnants or clipped anatomy in reviewed display conditions.
Raw component counts4..20 include low-alpha specks; counts alone were not treated as faults or cleaned. Their light/dark compositions showed no distracting dirt at app/maxcanvas size.
Fine warm-brown line and soft paper fill remain readable at the intended app size and the larger567px canvas diagnostic.

scale_and_support_review.calibration: One head-plate ratio transfer per sheet from measured neutral standing531px; each sheet reference remains common across all its poses. Full method/ROIs are in registration-spec.
scale_and_support_review.anchor_policy: Declared anatomy/contact support and independent contact-band observation retain their measured offset; contact-band midpoint is not substituted for an unrelated canvas centre. Normal tap_pop/success_air retain explicit inferred ground/native lift; app should not add another jump.

sequence_review.status: discrete-key-poses-reviewed; final runtime timing remains to be integrated
observations: Order communicates tap squash/rebound, thinking/aha, success preparation/air/landing/cheer and reassurance/retry.
Seated rest/stretch/nap maintain head/body scale and support registration; seated-to-tap is an intentional posture change requiring scene timing.
No interpolation, artificial limb motion, added secondary jump, or live app playback is asserted by these source previews.

selection.delegation: User requested creation/management and delegated quality-based adoption of new material.
